title: feat(locales): add Norwegian Nynorsk (nn) locale
body:
Adds a Norwegian **Nynorsk** (`nn`) locale for Zod v4 error messages.

Zod already ships a generic Norwegian (`no`, in practice Bokmål); this adds Nynorsk as a separate written standard (variants are encouraged per the locale-contribution guide). The file mirrors `no.ts` exactly in structure — only the message text is changed to Nynorsk — and `nn` is exported from `index.ts` alphabetically (between `nl` and `no`).

AI disclosure: the translation was produced with AI assistance (Claude) and reviewed by me, a native Norwegian speaker. Note: I'm more fluent in Bokmål than in Nynorsk, so a Nynorsk reviewer's pass on wording would be welcome.

I wasn't able to run the full `pnpm test` suite locally — happy to fix anything CI flags.

reviews.body:
> [!IMPORTANT] > The locale file itself looks correct, but `jsr.json` and the docs list are not updated — the locale won't be importable via JSR subpath exports and won't appear in the locale reference table. **Reviewed changes** — Adds a Norwegian Nynorsk (`nn`) locale mirroring the existing Bokmål (`no.ts`) structure, with translated error message strings and an `index.ts` barrel export. - **Add `packages/zod/src/v4/locales/nn.ts`** — full locale file with `Sizable`, `FormatDictionary`, `TypeDictionary`, and all switch cases translated to Nynorsk. - **Add `export { default as nn }` to `locales/index.ts`** — correctly placed alphabetically between `nl` and `no`. ### ⚠️ Missing `jsr.json` and docs entries for `nn` The new locale file exists in the source tree and is exported from `index.ts`, but it isn't registered in `jsr.json`'s subpath exports or listed in `packages/docs/content/error-customization.mdx`'s locale reference table. Without the `jsr.json` entry the locale won't be importable via JSR (`"zod/v4/locales/nn"`). Without the docs entry it's invisible in the official locale list.
Technical details ````markdown # Missing jsr.json and docs entries for nn ## Affected sites - `packages/zod/jsr.json:47-48` — `"./v4/locales/nn"` entry missing between `"./v4/locales/nl"` and `"./v4/locales/no"`. - `packages/docs/content/error-customization.mdx:377-378` — `nn` locale doc entry missing between `nl` and `no`. ## Required outcome - Add `"./v4/locales/nn": "./src/v4/locales/nn.ts"` to `jsr.json` between the `nl` and `no` lines (alphabetical). - Add `- \`nn\` — Norwegian Nynorsk` to the locale list in `error-customization.mdx` between the `nl` and `no` entries (alphabetical). ````

inline.body:
⚠️ The frontmatter opening delimiter was changed from `---` to `—---` (em dash + hyphens). MDX/YAML frontmatter parsers require exactly `---` as the delimiter — an em dash won't be recognized, which will break metadata extraction and potentially page rendering.

Revert line 1 back to `---` (three hyphens, no em dash).
